architecture: API-backed global corpus + curated local evidence graph

canonical_taxonomy.notes: MATERIA uses the live 3LR endpoint for browsing/search and keeps release metadata for reproducibility. COL release identifiers can churn between monthly releases; stable annual snapshots should be archived for publication-grade analyses.

data_policy.taxonomy: Include accepted taxa and preserve synonym relationships.
data_policy.chemistry: Only attach a compound to an organism when a source explicitly supports the relationship.
data_policy.evidence: Traditional use, community phenomenology and clinical evidence remain separate provenance layers.
data_policy.safety: Interactions, adverse events, toxicity and uncertainty are first-class relationships.
data_policy.completeness: Global taxonomy is browsable through the live provider rather than copied into a single GitHub Pages JSON payload.
